# Session 1: Fog over Saltmere

The party arrived in Saltmere, a fishing town on the Lantern Coast, after three days on the coast road. Harbormaster Oswin Pell met them at the docks. Oswin Pell is 52 years old and has run the harbor for twenty years.

Oswin Pell told them that eleven fishermen have gone missing since midsummer. He begged the party to find them. Oswin mentioned his daughter, Elsabet, who keeps the harbor ledgers.

The party took rooms at the Drowned Lantern tavern. Bettany Crane, the innkeeper, gave Iska a free drink after Iska won a game of knucklebones. Bettany Crane said strange lights burn at Greywatch Lighthouse on moonless nights, even though the lighthouse was abandoned years ago.

Dorran prayed at the shrine by the docks. Sefa bought a tide chart from a peddler.

## GM only

The Order of the Pale Tide is taking the fishermen to the drowned caves beneath Greywatch Lighthouse. Lady Maren Ashcombe leads the Order of the Pale Tide.

GM: Bettany Crane knows more than she says; her brother was one of the first to vanish.
